deviceClass: ordinary tablet; Edge and phone untouched
route: ARM64 Steam -> FEX -> sniper x86-64 Godot/MegaDot CoreCLR 9.0.7 -> native Vulkan/Venus -> Maleoon 910 -> NativeBuffer

mainThreadResolve.note: cumulative operation wall time, not frame cost; nested counters must not be added

baseline.extentNote: Actual Vulkan swapchain extent; X11 window geometry differs and is not render resolution.

fix.contract: After one parent resolution, reuse physical leaf metadata for lstat/nofollow stat variants and avoid a second parent resolution in readlink. No persistent path cache.

deviceCandidate.note: Controlled diagnostic package based on the installed 1.5.3 payload; only POSIX companion and two manifests replaced. Full branch HAP rebuild not performed.

hsl.note: Sequential same-device reference; user subsequently played cards in VPP, so later scene is not pixel-identical. No claim of strict interleaved benchmark.

vppBattle.note: Normal diagnostic-free 1.5.3 control. Earlier 2-3 FPS rose naturally to 13-18 without a code or quality change. Never count that warmup as optimization benefit.

input.observed: Game pause image remained visible, X11 focus was Steam, and HUD rose to 30 FPS while game button failed. Faster HUD in this state is not a valid active-game performance result.
input.fix: On real Wayland pointer/keyboard enter send EWMH activation; primary activation clears a remembered child only when known distinct PIDs and no transient/leader/group relation prove it unrelated. Preserve legacy CEF chooser handling. No focus polling.
input.hostTests: Xvfb desktop 3 cases; real XTEST/Wayland input and native WSI synchronization passed; regression failed before fix.
input.deviceFixScope: Short standard-device acceptance after complete offline repair: main menu, touch opens settings after activation, keyboard Escape returns, menu confirmation exits; no manual XSetInputFocus. Intermittent long-session focus-loss elimination and battle performance are not proven.

currentSample.note: Sample share is not frame time and does not prove the whole gap. Non-root user-cycle-only sample was invalid and excluded.

delivery.sourceBuild: Incremental proRelease HAP, payload audit, final HAP/offline pairing and local signature verification passed. Ordinary-tablet complete offline repair, automatic companion SHA verification, native Spire2 menu/input/normal exit passed. Remote CI not run.
